name: write_atomic / with_retry

test_list.description: 8 threads writing the same destination all succeed and the file holds the bytes.
An operation failing twice with OS error 32 (sharing violation) succeeds on the third attempt.
A permanently failing retryable operation returns its error after the attempt budget.
NotFound is returned on the first attempt.
A failed write leaves no temp file and no destination.
On Windows, a destination held open with share mode 0 is retried until released.

output_description: Destination atomically holds bytes or is untouched.
